title: TaskResult
description: What a knight publishes to `<prefix>.results.<taskId>`. Optional fields are only present when set, so the payload stays additive; consumers ignore fields they do not know.

knight.description: The knight that ran the task.

success.description: False when the task produced no deliverable; `error` then says why.

result.description: Task output, or the failure message when `success` is false.

result_truncated.description: The `result` text was cut to fit the NATS payload limit (RESULT_MAX_BYTES): the head and the tail are kept with a `[... N bytes omitted ...]` line between them. Absent when the text is whole.

cost.description: USD. claude-knight in subscription mode reports the API-equivalent cost, not billed.

model.description: The model actually used, whether or not the task carried an override.

tool_calls.description: pi-knight: tool calls the agent made.

billing.description: How the run is billed. claude-knight: `subscription` or `api`. pi-knight: `local` for an operator-supplied model endpoint (cost 0).

items.description: A pull request the task opened or updated.

prs.description: Pull requests the task opened or updated (omitted when none).

verdict.description: Review verdict from a final `Verdict:` line (omitted when none).

refused.description: Machine-readable refusal: the task did not run for affordability. `credits`: the provider is out of credits (e.g. OpenRouter 402), which does not reset on its own, so escalate. `quota`: a plan quota window is used up (claude-knight subscription), which resets later, so defer and re-run.

transient.description: The task failed because the model provider was briefly unavailable, after the runtime's own retries. Safe to retry later. Never set for a task that failed on its own terms or was refused.

transientReason.description: Why a transient failure happened. `overloaded`: the provider answered HTTP 529. `provider_5xx`: it answered 500, 502, 503 or 504. `network`: a connection reset or timeout to the provider.

usage_limited.description: Deprecated: use `refused: "quota"`. claude-knight still sends it alongside `refused` until the operator reads `refused` (roundtable-k8s/roundtable#431).

lost.description: The task was delivered to a knight that stopped before finishing it (max_deliver=1); it was not re-run.

attempt.description: Echo of the task's attempt number (set only on a manual retry).

retry_of.description: Echo of the task's `retryOf` (set only on a manual retry).

task.description: The task text, capped at 64 KB.
The original task, on failure results only (`success: false`, including `lost`), so the operator can dead-letter and retry it.
